verdict.rationale: Ramp's own materials say the product captures receipts and auto-fills memos and categories on swipe, codes expenses to the correct GL account, and suggests memos (CLI memo-suggestions). Ramp Intelligence also positions AI agents as flagging fraud and scanning transactions in real time for anomalies, with OCR claimed at 99% line-item accuracy. Missing for 10: explicit duplicate-expense detection, documentation of how fraud and anomaly detection works, and independent or hands-on corroboration of coding accuracy.
